userStories.title: Widen frozen-comparand operator alternation and add a correct left anchor
userStories.description: As a plan-time lint author, I need INTEGER_COMPARAND_RE to catch every shell comparison operator (not just -eq/-ge/-le/==) and to stop matching operators embedded mid-token, so the frozen-comparand rule finally catches the `test $X -gt 41` shape (CAM-377) it was written for, without inventing new false positives.
acceptanceCriteria: INTEGER_COMPARAND_RE matches all eight comparison operators -eq, -ne, -gt, -lt, -ge, -le, == and !=, each followed by optional whitespace and a literal integer. RED-on-main (swept at spec time, exit 1 naming -ne/-gt/-lt/!= as MISSED; prints OPS=8 so a zero-iteration sweep is visibly vacuous). [oracle: bun -e 'const {RULES}=await import("./src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts");const r=RULES.find(x=>x.name==="frozen-comparand");const ops=["-eq","-ne","-gt","-lt","-ge","-le","==","!="];let bad=0;for(const o of ops){const c="test $(wc -l < scripts/cam/patterns.md) "+o+" 3";if(r.test(c)===null){console.log("MISSED:"+c);bad++}}console.log("OPS="+ops.length);process.exit(bad||ops.length!==8?1:0)' .]

The operator must be preceded by start-of-string or whitespace, so an operator embedded mid-token or behind a second hyphen does not match; a left word-boundary is insufficient because the hyphen is a non-word char, so the anchor must exclude BOTH word characters and the hyphen. RED-on-main (swept at spec time, exit 1, all four cases FALSELY FLAGGED; prints CASES=4). [oracle: bun -e 'const {RULES}=await import("./src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts");const r=RULES.find(x=>x.name==="frozen-comparand");const cs=["cmd --ge 5","echo foo-eq 42","run --eq 7","test $(foo-eq 42)"];let bad=0;for(const c of cs){if(r.test(c)!==null){console.log("FALSELY FLAGGED:"+c);bad++}}console.log("CASES="+cs.length);process.exit(bad||cs.length!==4?1:0)' .]

The frozen-comparand flagged-forms describe block gains at least one test per newly covered operator (-ne, -gt, -lt, !=) following the existing 'flags X' naming convention, and no existing test is deleted or weakened; the total test count in test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts strictly exceeds main's count derived live at check time. [oracle: file-assert test $(grep -c "\btest(" test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts) -gt $(git show main:test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts | grep -c "\btest(")]

All four rules in RULES remain present and named exactly as on main (grep-q-plus-list-files, frozen-comparand, rotating-artifact-target, zero-match-vacuous); RULES.length equals main's value derived live at check time, not a frozen literal. [oracle: bun -e 'const {RULES}=await import("./src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts");const names=RULES.map(r=>r.name).sort().join(",");const exp=["frozen-comparand","grep-q-plus-list-files","rotating-artifact-target","zero-match-vacuous"].sort().join(",");console.log("COUNT="+RULES.length);process.exit(names===exp&&RULES.length===4?0:1)' .]

userStories.title: Scope the derivation excuse per clause instead of per whole command
userStories.description: As a plan-time lint author, I need hasFrozenIntegerComparand to excuse a frozen integer comparand only when a live-derivation token appears in the SAME clause, so one `git grep ... main` token can no longer excuse three unrelated frozen literals elsewhere in the command, while a legitimate same-clause sanity floor stays excused.
acceptanceCriteria: The derivation excuse is scoped per clause: a live-derivation token excuses an integer comparand only inside the same clause (the second case is the one-token-excuses-three-comparands shape). RED-on-main (swept at spec time, exit 1, both cases WRONGLY EXCUSED; prints CASES=2). [oracle: bun -e 'const {RULES}=await import("./src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts");const r=RULES.find(x=>x.name==="frozen-comparand");const cs=["test $(git show main:a.ts | wc -l) -ge 1 && test $(wc -l < b.ts) -eq 42","git grep -c X main; test $Y -eq 7; test $Z -eq 8; test $W -eq 9"];let bad=0;for(const c of cs){if(r.test(c)===null){console.log("WRONGLY EXCUSED:"+c);bad++}}console.log("CASES="+cs.length);process.exit(bad||cs.length!==2?1:0)' .]

PINNING, deliberately GREEN-on-main: clause splitting operates on the quote-stripped text, not the raw command, so quoted payloads made inert by CAM-388 are not resurrected as clause delimiters. If it goes red, the implementation split the raw command. [oracle: bun -e 'const {RULES}=await import("./src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts");const r=RULES.find(x=>x.name==="frozen-comparand");const c="grep -qF \"a && b -eq 3\" f.ts";console.log("CASES=1");process.exit(r.test(c)===null?0:1)' .]

PINNING, deliberately GREEN-on-main: the legitimate same-clause sanity floor (a `git show main:` derivation paired with a `-ge 1` floor) stays excused; if it goes red, the implementation chose the rejected no-escape-hatch direction and is over-flagging. [oracle: bun -e 'const {RULES}=await import("./src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts");const r=RULES.find(x=>x.name==="frozen-comparand");const c="test $(git show main:file.ts | wc -l) -ge 1 && test $(wc -l < file.ts) -eq $(git show main:file.ts | wc -l)";console.log("CASES=1");process.exit(r.test(c)===null?0:1)' .]

The frozen-comparand passing-cases and flagged-forms blocks gain at least one mixed-clause test (one clause derived, another frozen), following the existing naming convention; no existing test is deleted or weakened, and the total test count strictly exceeds main's count derived live at check time. [oracle: file-assert test $(grep -c "\btest(" test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts) -gt $(git show main:test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts | grep -c "\btest(")]

hasFrozenIntegerComparand still returns a single RuleFinding | null per command (the OracleLintRule contract) even when more than one clause is at fault, and its reason text stays accurate in that case. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

All four rules in RULES remain present and named exactly as on main (grep-q-plus-list-files, frozen-comparand, rotating-artifact-target, zero-match-vacuous); RULES.length equals main's value derived live at check time, not a frozen literal. userStories.title: Promote the CAM-382 false-positive cases into the executed matrix and extend the fixture-shape guard
userStories.description: As a CI maintainer, I need the false-positive reproduction cases that currently live only in the un-executed cam382-false-positives.txt to become rows in the table-driven oracle-lint-cases.txt matrix, and the fixture-shape guard to require double-quoted-wrapper and backslash-escape rows, so the CAM-382 defect can never again be a tracked-but-unrun reproduction that passes CI while broken.
acceptanceCriteria: The inner cases currently living ONLY in test/fixtures/oracle-lint/cam382-false-positives.txt are now rows in test/fixtures/oracle-lint/oracle-lint-cases.txt (the wrapper `bun -e '...'` commands are extracted to their inner cases, since the `-e` payload is not scanned by the rule), and are therefore executed by the table-driven test. The live (non-comment, non-blank) row count of oracle-lint-cases.txt strictly exceeds main's count derived live at check time, AND a row exists whose command is the `cmd --ge 5` long-flag false positive with expected verdict ok. Red against main. [oracle: file-assert test $(grep -cvE '^(#|$)' test/fixtures/oracle-lint/oracle-lint-cases.txt) -gt $(git show main:test/fixtures/oracle-lint/oracle-lint-cases.txt | grep -cvE '^(#|$)') && grep -qF 'frozen-comparand :: ok :: cmd --ge 5' test/fixtures/oracle-lint/oracle-lint-cases.txt]

The fixture-shape guard requires at least one double-quoted interpreter-wrapper row and at least one backslash-escape row (in addition to the dimensions it already counts) and ASSERTS on those counts rather than merely computing them. Mutation-falsifiable: copying the fixture to a temp path with every double-quoted wrapper row stripped and running the shape guard against that copy produces a NON-ZERO exit, and the stripped-row count is printed so a zero-mutation run is visibly vacuous. [oracle: named-command bun test ./test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts -t 'shape' — plus the in-test mutation described, swept red by injecting a stripped-copy fixture]
Every named rule referenced by a matrix row still resolves in RULES, and every matrix row classifies as its recorded ok/flag verdict. [oracle: bun test ./test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts]

userStories.notes: Three comment/name-only edits, no behavior change. CAM-384: rename the test at test file lines 203-206 from 'does not match main by literal substring -- mainbranch is not the main token' to the positive form (e.g. 'flags a mainbranch: ref, which is not the main token'); change ONLY the name, keep command + `.not.toBeNull()` byte-identical (this test lives in the 'flagged forms' describe, so the negative-sounding name violated the 'flags X'/'does not flag X' convention). CAM-392: move the extractCommandSubstitutionSpans JSDoc block (currently at lines ~283-292, above findCommandSubstitutionEnd) down to sit directly above `function extractCommandSubstitutionSpans` at line 300; comment-only, no code motion, and extractCommandSubstitutionSpans body must not be otherwise altered (CAM-389 is out of scope).
